synopsis: Set during the era of The Phantom Menace, this action game casts players as the Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi. Armed with a lightsaber and the Force, Obi-Wan battles the Trade Federation’s droid armies, bounty hunters, and other underworld threats across Coruscant, Tatooine, and Naboo, culminating in a duel with the Sith apprentice Darth Maul.
title: Obi-Wan
